     2x + 3 - 3 = 7 - 3
     \]

     \[
     2x = 4
     \]
     Next, divide both sides by 2:

     \]

     \[
     \begin{cases}
     x + y = 5 \\
     2x - y = 1
     \end{cases}
     \]

     \[
     (x + y) + (2x - y) = 5 + 1
     \]

     \[

A square has a side length of 5 units. A circle is inscribed in this square. What is the area of the circle?

2. **Determine the radius of the inscribed circle:** Since the circle is inscribed in the square, the diameter of the circle is equal to the side length of the square.    \]
